messages:
Clara (CS): Heads up — Tidewell just uploaded a vendor risk form + proposed DPA amendment. Need a quick triage before our onboarding call tomorrow morning.

Jon (Onboarding): Can you drop the link? Ill start mapping to our evidence checklist.

Clara (CS): Link: https://files.example.com/tidewell_vrf.pdf. TL;DR from customer: SOC2 attestation requested, EU-only residency, BYOK for master keys, embeddings retention 90 days, 30-day deletion SLA for exported data.

Ravi (Security): Quick read: SOC2 ok. EU-only routing means hosted-api is risky unless we can guarantee eu-region-only and no cross-region fallback. BYOK ok for Dedicated/Private but requires KMS integration and subprocessors detail. 30d deletion tighter than our 60d default 1 flag Legal.

Priya (Legal): A couple notes: they ask for subprocessors list + periodic certification updates. We typically commit to 60d for deletion; 30d will need either extra attestation clauses or a negotiated compromise. I can draft a 45-day counter-provision with certified deletion language.

Jon (Onboarding): Options to present on the call:
- Hosted: likely NO for EU-only + BYOK.
- Dedicated (eu-west) + BYOK: feasible, recommend.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): fallback for full isolation.
Ill also prepare an ops runbook + rough timeline for KMS setup.

Anika (Infra): We support BYOK wrapping for Dedicated. Customer must supply key material and cert chain + KMS endpoint details. Note: eu-west Dedicated pools will incur ~30-60ms median additional latency depending on client geography. Also confirm whether they require HSM-backed keys vs cloud-KMS.

Ravi (Security): If Dedicated+BYOK chosen, we'll need: subprocessors list, KMS integration checklist, key-rotation responsibilities, and an embedding-PII decision from the customer (affects retention).

Clara (CS): Ill ask them whether embeddings are PII. They want answers by 10:00am PST tomorrow. Priya: can Legal accept 45d?

Priya (Legal): Yes we can propose 45 days conditioned on certified deletion procedures and audit rights. Ill draft the amendment language and include the subprocessors cadence (quarterly disclosure).

Jon (Onboarding): Drafted a short config snippet for the onboarding packet (sanity-check please):

```
model_deployment: "dedicated-eu-west"
kms_mode: "BYOK"
customer_kms: true
require_cert_chain: true
data_retention: {
  embeddings_days: 90,
  exported_data_deletion_days: 45
}
```

Jon (Onboarding): Ravi/Anika can you sanity-check the tech checklist by EOD? If yes, Ill send the counter-proposal + options to the customer before the call.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot toggled checklist item `DPA signed` -> pending for account `tidewell-prod`.

Clara (CS): On call in 30m, will report back after customer replies. :thumbsup:
